body:
## What it does

Traffic is starting to arrive as software rather than as people, and most sites were never built for that. This grades yours on how well a machine can read it, follow it and settle up with it, then hands over one fix a day that you can drop straight in, re-checking after each change until the score tops out. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @RobautoAI shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
